As of 20:00 on June 16, the earthquake had resulted in 1 person killed and 4 injured. The Ministry of Emergency Management activated the National Level IV Emergency Response for Earthquake Disasters, and Qinghai Province activated the Provincial Level II Emergency Response for Earthquake Disasters. As of 08:00 on June 17, a total of 115 aftershocks had been recorded, with the largest aftershock measuring 4.9 in magnitude. The seismogenic structure is the Dachaidan-Zongwulongshan Fault Zone, and the epicenter is located within an Intensity VIII seismic fortification zone. 1 Disaster Background The earthquake occurred within the western part of the Qaidam-Qilian Block in the northern Qinghai–Xizang Plateau . The epicenter was located within the Zongwulongshan Fault Zone, situated between the northern margin of the Tsaidam Basin and the western segment of the Qilian Mountains. This fault zone is one of the important active structures accommodating internal deformation within the western part of the block. The seismogenic structure for this earthquake is the Dachaidan-Zongwulongshan Fault Zone, with the Dachaidan Fault being the most likely candidate for the causative fault.
